newsitem.title: FRANCE: 7,747 candidates to contest Algeria election.
newsitem.headline: 7,747 candidates to contest Algeria election.

text.p: A total of 7,747 candidates will contest Algeria's June 5 parliamentary election, the official APS news agency said on Friday.
Quoting the independent watchdog body for the vote, it said: "The number of candidates agreed by Algeria's elections national commission who stand for legislative elections is 7,747."
The future National Assembly will have 380 seats with eight for Algerian expatriates, the agency said.
The candidates were registered on 753 lists, of which 68 represented independent candidates. "The remaining lists were sponsored by 39 political parties and one alliance," APS said.
The government has announced that foreign observers and local party activists will be allowed to watch the polls to allay opposition fears that authorities could rig the election.

President Liamine Zeroual sees the election as a way out of the crisis that erupted after the authorities in January 1992 cancelled a general election in which radical Islamists had taken a huge lead.
Since then about 60,000 people have been killed.
